rows.en: So that's it...!! That's what they call the Psycho Gundam Mk-II!!
That big lug, huh...!! Psycho-whatsit!!
That Gundam...!! It's huge... Look at the size of it!!
That enemy...!!
That enemy...!!
That enemy...!!
That enemy...!!
That enemy...!!
Ugh... The explosion...
And at that very moment!!
That's... the particle cannon!! The base...!?
What!? A high-energy reading!? The particle cannon!!
Gwaah...!!!
A direct hit!?
Kyaah!!
Base!! Respond!! What's your situation!?
No good...
Please! Somebody answer!!
Zoffy!! Zoffy!! Can't you hear me!?
"I-I'm all right."
...Zoffy!!
"We're safe, somehow. It seems... we just barely avoided a direct hit."
Just barely...?
I see! The Psycho Gundam Mk-II's explosion knocked its line of fire slightly off.
"But if it fires again, we won't be able to hold out."
"Cherudim here. Nice work! A lucky break in a bad spot, but it buys us a little time."
"Hurry to the Terminal Unit while you've got the chance."
Are you sure you're all right over there?
"We've managed to regroup. And our enemy friends look pretty rattled."
"At this rate, we can take down the particle cannon!"
Understood.
...But how are we supposed to get there? The way down to the Middle Layer is blocked, remember?
Let's see... ...Hm!?
What is it?
Look at that crack. It's right where the Psycho Gundam Mk-II exploded.
...Looks like we can get inside the Cube through there.
Our mission is the Terminal Unit. Let's leave stopping the particle cannon to Cherudim's team.
This must be... the Middle Layer... The Terminal Unit is close!
...Meanwhile
Hm...? The enemy has entered the Middle Layer...!?
Yes, I sensed it too. But how could such lowly heroes...!
There's no need to let it bother you.
Reborns Gundam... But the fact is, they overwhelmed us...
You did rather well, considering you had no backup from Veda.
The Upper Layer is too far from Veda, after all.
Then are we just going to sit back and do nothing!?
No... I intend to send out Regnant.
Regnant...!! Is it already fit for actual combat!?
This room... It looks a lot like the control room on the Upper Layer.
Are those surveillance monitors lining the walls? They're showing footage from inside the Cube...
Hey, there's something at the back there.
That's it!! That's the Terminal Unit.
That thing!?
If I get inside it, I can access Veda.
Huh, so that's how it is. Then hurry it up!
"BEEP, BEEP, BEEP, BEEP..."
...It's a transmission.
"This is Cherudim! Mission complete! We've taken the particle cannon's control room."
Well done!
"Yeah, now all that's left is to take back Veda. Seravee, I'm counting on you!"
I'm just about to enter the Terminal Unit now.
"Oh, yeah? Looks like our luck's finally turning!"
What the!?
It's coming from the door!!
I won't let youuuuuu!!
...You're...!! Regnant!!
Hah, hah... So you knooow me!! You know who I am!!
I see... So you're the Lost Heroes!?
You... are the evil that throws the world into chaos!! If only you were all gooone!!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll take this one on!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll take this one on!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll take this one on!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! Leave this one to us!!
Seravee! Hurry to the Terminal Unit! We'll take this one on!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We will take this one on!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll take this one on!

notes.note: #0.1-15 leader block (TextIdOffset+0+k), Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0625.bla: Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), God, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1. So #0.8 = W (Shotaro), #0.9 = Momotaros ('Psycho-whatsit', as story_114 #0.67), #0.10 = God Gundam, #0.11-15 = Taro/Seven/Ultraman/RX/Rider 1 (identical text, identical English).
Seravee caught near the Psycho Gundam Mk-II's explosion after the boss fight (inferred from #0.49/#0.60).
Narration; 'to, sono toki' rendered 'And at that very moment!!'.
Zoffy at the base: 'kou-enerugii-tai' = high-energy object/reading detected.
Unlabelled grunt; not traced to a named speaker (someone at the base during the impact).
Unlabelled; speaker not recovered (likely Zoffy or a base member reacting to the hit). 'A direct hit!?' needs no subject.
Radio lines in source corner brackets rendered in double quotes, matching earlier comm/announcer lines. #0.40/#0.43 = dead air.
'Tanomu' here is Seravee pleading into the radio, so 'Please!'.
Zoffy speaks for the base: 'we'. 'Wazuka ni' -> 'just barely', echoed by Seravee in #0.48.
'Shajiku' (firing axis) -> 'line of fire'; 'its' = the particle cannon's.
'Teki-san' (Lockon's casual, mocking 'Mr. Enemy') -> 'our enemy friends'.
Ankh; subject 'we' restored. 'Middle Layer' / 'Upper Layer' follow DungeonName (system slices) and story_113.
Narration; '...Meanwhile' (source has no trailing ellipsis).
'???' = Reborns Gundam (named by Gadessa in #0.5).
Regnant glossary g=n -> 'it'.
Subject 'I' restored: Seravee is the one who accesses Veda (cf. story_117 #0.45).
Subject 'I' restored (Seravee entering the unit); could be 'we', but story_117 #0.45 has Seravee going in alone.
'???' = Regnant bursting in (named in #0.24).
Unlabelled; Regnant continuing #0.26 (same line labelled Regnant in story_117 #0.46). Elongated ending kept as 'gooone'.

#0.29-43 leader block (TextIdOffset+28+k), chain in 0629.bla: 00, Nu, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Rider 1, RX, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Zero, Mebius, Den-O. So #0.29 00, #0.30 Nu, #0.31 Wing Zero, #0.32 God Gundam ('hikiuketa!!' -> 'Leave this one to us!!'), #0.33 Zeta ('hurry'), #0.34 Rider 1 ('watashi-tachi' -> slightly formal 'We will'), #0.35 RX. 'Koitsu' = Regnant, g=n -> 'this one'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped via Pt_Chara_Check chains (0625: Zeta..Rider 1; 0629: 00..Den-O). Uncertain: 0625 #0.26 and #0.30 speakers not recovered; 0629 #0.15 'I' vs 'we'. Radio lines in double quotes. Not in glossary: Psycho Gundam Mk-II, Terminal Unit, particle cannon, Middle/Upper Layer (match earlier slices).
